page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, the instance provides dedicated physical execution resources without hyperthreading, ensuring consistent compute performance for demanding workloads.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature of this server is its integrated local storage, which consists of 11519 GB of SSD capacity. This high-density local storage is bundled directly with the instance, offering substantial capacity for data-intensive operations.

For external connectivity, the ecs.i3.13xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores, a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, and massive bundled local SSD storage positions this instance as a resource-dense option for workloads requiring high local storage throughput without the overhead of external storage attachments.

Given these hardware specifications, the ecs.i3.13xlarge is suited for large-scale relational databases, NoSQL databases, data warehousing, and distributed file systems. The dedicated core allocation and large local SSD capacity also make it appropriate for transactional processing and analytics workloads that demand low-latency storage access.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is an x86_64 server instance running on the KVM hypervisor, designed for storage-intensive and memory-heavy workloads. It features 52 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration that ensures dedicated compute resources. The hardware profile includes 384.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.38 GB per core, alongside a substantial 11519 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. Lacking a GPU, this instance focuses its resource density on high-capacity local storage and dedicated CPU performance. This configuration makes the ecs.i3.13xlarge highly efficient for large-scale databases, data warehousing, and low-latency transactional applications requiring significant local storage capacity.
